prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production TRANSPARENT CUTOUT ANIMATION RIG ATLAS, NOT a sequence of full character poses.
REFERENCE is approved undead Ursa Major armoured anthro-BROWN-BEAR knight. Preserve exactly the broad torn bear muzzle, ragged round ears, milky eye, skeletal cheek, brown fur, huge battered iron plates, skull belt, crimson cloth and rusty broadsword, detailed illustrated pixel-art style. All parts viewed in SAME RIGHT-FACING side/slight-three-quarter camera; never mirror a part. This atlas will be assembled into ONE walking character with joint rotation. Make the artwork faithful and the parts anatomically complete under overlapping joints.
EXACTLY NINE SEPARATE PARTS in an evenly spaced THREE COLUMN by THREE ROW grid on a SQUARE 2048x2048 canvas. Each part centered, generous empty alpha gutters, NO part touching neighbouring cell. NO text/labels. No assembled character anywhere. Cells read left to right then down:
1 TOP LEFT: complete joined UPPER BODY from bear ears down to belt and short overlapping hip armour. Head, neck, chest, both complete arms and paws. Same sword held LOW in original near paw angled down-right, entire sword visible. Free far claw down. NO thighs, NO shins, NO feet. NO hanging cape or long tabard, separate those into cells2 and3. Belt and short iron tassets end at upper thigh so animated legs can tuck behind. Keep natural width and heavy bearish silhouette, not cropped edges.
2 TOP MIDDLE: only the detached long ragged CRIMSON BACK CAPE, including shoulder attachment and trailing torn hem, profile draping down-back LEFT, no bear body or limbs.
3 TOP RIGHT: only the detached long narrow ragged CRIMSON FRONT TABARD with faint worn gold pattern, hanging straight down from skull belt to knee/shin height, no body or buckle.
4 MIDDLE LEFT: NEAR THIGH only, thick bearish fur and battered overlapping iron thigh plates, from rounded hip joint to rounded knee joint. Vertical neutral rest, top points up, knee down. Include concealed overlap at both ends.
5 MIDDLE MIDDLE: NEAR SHIN only, same iron knee-cap and tall battered greave over brown fur, from knee pivot to ankle pivot. Vertical neutral rest, no foot. Include complete rounded knee armour that overlaps thigh naturally.
6 MIDDLE RIGHT: NEAR FOOT only, broad plantigrade clawed brown bear hind-paw with iron ankle cuff and large dark claws pointing RIGHT. Complete flat sole, profile foot, no human boot. Cuff extends up to overlap greave.
7 BOTTOM LEFT: FAR THIGH only, matching but darker/shadowed, rounded hip to knee, vertical neutral rest, same construction as4.
8 BOTTOM MIDDLE: FAR SHIN only, darker matching knee-cap/greave, knee to ankle, vertical neutral rest, same construction as5.
9 BOTTOM RIGHT: FAR FOOT only, darker matching flat plantigrade brown bear hind-paw with iron ankle cuff/claws pointing RIGHT, same construction as6.
Parts 4-9 are distinct SINGLE isolated anatomical parts, not full legs, no duplicated legs, no whole figures. Parts 4 and7 one thigh each;5and8 one greave each;6and9 one paw each. Body1 must have ZERO legs or feet. Keep TWO arms attached tobody1 and sword in SAME paw. Each piece large, crisp, richly detailed. Alpha ZERO transparent background outside parts: no dark haze, glow, gradients, floor, shadows, guide marks, checkerboard or outlines of removed limbs. All isolated pieces entirely inside their own cells. Upper body most important: preserve exact approved head and broad plated bear knight identity.
